graham.brief:
Christian McCaffrey's touches climbed from 14 to 20 last week. Is the bigger load McCaffrey's new role? A role like that would make McCaffrey's early games the wrong baseline. Across the season McCaffrey has had 45% of the San Francisco carries.

The 48.5 total and the spread leave San Francisco about 25.5 points to score. A higher-scoring San Francisco day tends to stretch McCaffrey's workload.

This week McCaffrey is set at 15.5 rush attempts, well over his 11.7 average across three games. Or three games of McCaffrey are simply a noisy baseline.

Most of the San Francisco carries going to McCaffrey would back the line, and a rotation would back his average. Watch who takes the first-down handoffs for San Francisco, since a changing role shows up there first.
